description: This file defines the FileRemove interface, which declares methods for removing files and collections of files related to content management within the sales manager application.

classes.name: FileRemove
classes.description: An interface specifying methods for removing files associated with a merchant store, including single file removal and batch removal.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific file associated with a merchant store, identified by store code, content type, and filename.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all files associated with a specific merchant store code.
